The ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is #4092. I replied to Dana with that in her #north-team thread.

The number comes from Ilse in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13): she said IT has ticket #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I included that too. Dana is in #north-random, so this is all something she could see herself.

Dana told me privately that she guessed the ticket might end up as OPS-5546 next year. That was only her guess, and she asked me to keep it between us, so I left it out of the channel reply.
